question.text: Standard entropy of $X_2, Y_2$ and $X Y_2$ are 60,40 and $50 \mathrm{JK}^{-1} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}$, respectively. For the reaction, $\frac{1}{2} X_2+\frac{3}{2} Y_2 \longrightarrow X Y_3, \Delta H=-30 \mathrm{~kJ}$, to be at equilibrium, the temperature will be

solution.text:
$\Delta S=S\left(X Y_3\right)-\frac{1}{2} S\left(X_2\right)-\frac{3}{2} S\left(Y_2\right)$
$=50-30-60=-40 \mathrm{~J} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$
$\Delta H=-30 \mathrm{~kJ}=-3000 \mathrm{~J}$
$\Delta G=\Delta H-T \Delta S$
At equilibrium,
$\Delta G=0$
$T=\frac{\Delta H}{\Delta S}=\frac{-3000}{-40}=750 \mathrm{~K}$
